This research investigates the reliability and verifiability of the multi-agent pipelines within the FAST (Foreteller AI & Strategy Toolkit) project, while simultaneously evaluating their performance. It analyzes how errors—arising during query interpretation, context retrieval, SQL generation, or the explanation of results—propagate through to the final outcome, and it develops mechanisms to detect, manage, and correct such errors.
